description:
Summary


Seeking a pragmatic Senior Solution Engineer focused on database development and performance. Candidate will design, build, and optimize data solutions (primarily SQL), work with Snowflake, and sometimes apply Python or other non‑SQL tools where appropriate. Must be curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new cloud and tooling patterns.


Key Responsibilities


Design, implement and maintain robust schemas and database objects, data ingestion flows and data exports.

Write, optimize and review complex SQL (queries, stored procedures, views, procedures, UDFs, UDTFs).

Diagnose and tune query and data process performance.

Build repeatable data ingestion, processing and transformation; use Python when logic is better expressed programmatically.

Use CI/CD and source control practices for database code (Git-based deployment).

Monitor data quality, alerting and job health; troubleshoot production incidents and implement long‑term fixes.

Stay current with cloud data patterns and recommend pragmatic architecture improvements.

Deliver reporting systems for fintech use cases, working with the product team to turn requirements into reliable data products

Collaborate with fellow data engineers on shared design, code reviews, and delivery

Work with the QA team to define test scenarios, validate data and reports, and resolve

defects before release


Required Qualifications


4+ years professional experience in data engineering/database development or related roles.

Good experience in query optimization and performance tuning.

Knowledge of Snowflake features and willingness to expand Snowflake knowledge.

Comfortable with Git and basic CI/CD concepts.

Good problem solving, communication and collaboration skills; able to work across teams.

Willingness to learn and apply non‑SQL solutions (Python, or other scripting languages, serverless tools) when appropriate.



Nice‑to‑Have


Python kowledge or experience.

Familiarity with cloud fundamentals (AWS, Azure or GCP).

Applied AI LLM coding-assistance experience.



Benefits:


We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career!

We maximise each employee’s potential through personal development through a wide range of learning tools both formal and informal. We believe in remunerating our people with competitive salaries and a range of attractive benefits such as:


  • 25 days’ holiday per year
  • 1 additional day off for your Birthday
  • Annual wellness allowance
  • Share Purchase Plan
  • Medical Health Insurance
  • Medical Subscription (preventive medical services)
  • Life insurance
  • Pillar 3 Private Pension
  • Meal Vouchers
  • Flexible Benefits
  • Bookster
  • Volunteering Events
  • All LSEG colleagues with at least one year’s continuous service, who become parents, are now entitled to at least 26 weeks’ paid leave, and the option to return to work on a phased basis, in relation with specific company’s policy and guidelines

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.


Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

 

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.


Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

 

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.


We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.


Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.


By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter.
